
cochange_table[[1]] should be referred to as `nodes_table`, where as `cochange_table[[2]]` should be referred to as `edgelist_table`.

Here's what `nodes_table` looks like, after the fix of part 1 in #184 (not committed yet at the time of this comment):

```
                        name  type   color
 1:              .gititgnore FALSE #f4dbb5
 2:                README.md FALSE #f4dbb5

 9:               .gitignore FALSE #f4dbb5
10:                  LICENSE FALSE #f4dbb5
11:               LICENSE.md FALSE #f4dbb5
```

As you can see, the all the files are listed here. 

Let me clarify what structure you are looking at for "cochange_table": When a graph (the circles with connections of your Social Smell cheatsheet) is represented in memory, you have a few options. One of them is representing them as a pair of tables: Nodes, which defines all information a node will have (e.g. the color of a node, it's size, etc), 

and an edgelist table. This edgelist table defines only the connections, which happens in **pairs**. In this code, you assumed that the edgelist contains all the nodes, but that assumption is not always true. 

Indeed, in this project, LICENSE.md is committed only once (during a file rename), and more importantly, it is committed without any other file. This leads to LICENSE.md having no connections to any other file in the entire of this git log, and thus will not appear on the edgelist table. **But it will appear on the node table**.
